description: Tag create. With confirm both languages reach label validation and agree; the no-confirm gate messages diverge (see report). Success POSTs the label-only body. A body that will not parse must fail rather than turn into a made-up tag. The two languages frame the parse failure differently, so the shared assertion is the parser's position marker.

cases.name: requires confirm
cases.expect_error: This creates a Linode tag. Set confirm=true to proceed.
